# Speech fixture provenance

`jfk.flac` is the short test fixture distributed in the MIT-licensed
[OpenAI Whisper repository](https://github.com/openai/whisper/blob/main/tests/jfk.flac).
It contains a public presidential-speech excerpt and is used only to prove that the real local
Faster-Whisper runtime loads, returns expected words, and emits word timestamps.
